verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no first-party documentation of per-channel, keyword, or schedule-based notification controls in Teams. The only on-topic material is community complaints that channel muting and unsubscribing are not possible and that notifications cannot be fully shut off. The Connectors item covers subscribing to external web-service messages, an adjacent feature that does not count toward this story.

support.subject: As a team-admin, I can tune notifications per channel, keyword, and schedule so only what matters interrupts me
